title: Accurate Mace: 2.0
description: The second coming of my mace, the 2.0.
body: The old 1.0 was literally a heavy core with a custom breeze rod texture, but in the new version, its the same concept but there are more holes to make it look more textured and improved! Here is the old version if your looking for a much more simple one. [Old version here!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cinbus-accurate-mace)
